## Overview

This document describes questionnaire missingness patterns before any inferential modelling.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(Hmisc)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(tinytable)
library(patchwork)

source(here("R", "io.R"))

followup_limit_days <- 182L

ensure_dir(here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive"))
ensure_dir(here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "figures"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
questionnaires <- read_parquet(here("output", "derived", "questionnaires.parquet")) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(days_since_first_contact),
    days_since_first_contact >= 0,
    days_since_first_contact <= followup_limit_days
  ) |>
  mutate(
    form_type = factor(form_type),
    form_type_label = factor(
      form_type,
      levels = c("long_version", "short_version"),
      labels = c("EORTC QLQ-C30", "Adapted QLQ-C15-based form")
    ),
    sex = factor(sex),
    ecog_baseline = forcats::fct_explicit_na(factor(ecog_baseline_analysis), "Missing")
  )

items <- read_parquet(here("output", "derived", "questionnaire_items_long.parquet")) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(days_since_first_contact),
    days_since_first_contact >= 0,
    days_since_first_contact <= followup_limit_days
  ) |>
  mutate(
    form_type = factor(form_type),
    form_type_label = factor(
      form_type,
      levels = c("long_version", "short_version"),
      labels = c("EORTC QLQ-C30", "Adapted QLQ-C15-based form")
    ),
    sex = factor(sex),
    ecog_baseline = forcats::fct_explicit_na(factor(ecog_baseline_analysis), "Missing")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: item-summaries
item_missingness <- items |>
  filter(!is_structural_absence) |>
  summarise(
    n_eligible = dplyr::n(),
    answer_rate = mean(is_answered),
    missingness = mean(is_missing_nonstructural),
    .by = c(form_type, form_type_label, item_code, item_position_within_form)
  ) |>
  arrange(form_type, item_position_within_form)

followup_item_inventory <- items |>
  filter(form_type == "short_version", !is_structural_absence) |>
  distinct(form_type, form_type_label, item_code, item_position_within_form) |>
  arrange(item_position_within_form)

questionnaire_missingness <- questionnaires |>
  mutate(
    any_missing_nonstructural = n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0,
    age_group = cut_number(age, n = 5),
    ecog_group = forcats::fct_explicit_na(factor(ecog_baseline), "Missing")
  )

pattern_summary <- list(
  questionnaire_describe = Hmisc::describe(questionnaires |>
    select(
      n_items_eligible,
      n_items_answered,
      n_items_missing_nonstructural,
      prop_missing_nonstructural,
      any_missing_nonstructural,
      n_terminal_missing,
      n_intermittent_missing
    )),
  item_describe = Hmisc::describe(items |>
    filter(!is_structural_absence) |>
    select(item_position_within_form, is_answered, is_missing_nonstructural))
)

write_parquet(item_missingness, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "item_missingness.parquet"))
write_parquet(followup_item_inventory, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "followup_item_inventory.parquet"))
write_parquet(questionnaire_missingness, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "questionnaire_missingness.parquet"))
saveRDS(pattern_summary, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "pattern_summary.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-helpers
make_position_bar <- function(data, title) {
  data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = item_position_within_form, y = missingness)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "grey40") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(max(data$item_position_within_form)),
      guide = guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = seq(0, 0.12, by = 0.02)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.11)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Item number",
      y = "Missingness"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

age_breaks <- c(18, 45, 55, 65, 75, Inf)
age_labels <- c("18\u201344", "45\u201354", "55\u201364", "65\u201374", "75+")

make_strata_plot <- function(data, form_label) {
  d <- data |>
    filter(form_type_label == form_label) |>
    mutate(
      age_group = cut(age, breaks = age_breaks, labels = age_labels, right = FALSE),
      ecog_group = as.character(ecog_baseline),
      sex = as.character(sex),
      language = as.character(language),
      marital_status = as.character(marital_status)
    )

  bind_rows(
    d |> summarise(prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0), .by = sex) |>
      rename(stratum = sex) |> mutate(stratum_type = "Sex"),
    d |> summarise(prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0), .by = age_group) |>
      rename(stratum = age_group) |> mutate(stratum_type = "Age group", stratum = as.character(stratum)),
    d |> summarise(prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0), .by = ecog_group) |>
      rename(stratum = ecog_group) |> mutate(stratum_type = "ECOG (baseline)"),
    d |> summarise(prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0), .by = language) |>
      rename(stratum = language) |> mutate(stratum_type = "Language"),
    d |> summarise(prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0), .by = marital_status) |>
      rename(stratum = marital_status) |> mutate(stratum_type = "Marital status")
  ) |>
    mutate(stratum_type = factor(stratum_type, levels = c("Sex", "Age group", "ECOG (baseline)", "Language", "Marital status"))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = stratum, y = prop_any_missing)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#176B87", width = 0.78, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(vars(stratum_type), scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(
      title = form_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Questionnaires with any missing item"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-position
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
position_plot <- {
  plots <- item_missingness |>
    group_by(form_type_label) |>
    group_map(~ make_position_bar(.x, as.character(.y$form_type_label)), .keep = TRUE)
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1)
}
save_plot_dual(position_plot, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "figures", "missingness_by_position"))
position_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-questionnaire-number
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
questionnaire_number_plot <- {
  qn_data <- questionnaires |>
    filter(form_type == "short_version") |>
    summarise(
      prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0),
      n = dplyr::n(),
      .by = questionnaire_number
    ) |>
    filter(n >= 10)

  ggplot(qn_data, aes(x = questionnaire_number, y = prop_any_missing)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = 0, label = paste0("n=", n)),
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 2.8,
      color = "grey60"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.05))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = qn_data$questionnaire_number) +
    labs(
      x = "Questionnaire number within patient",
      y = "Questionnaires with any missing item",
      subtitle = "Adapted QLQ-C15-based forms with \u226510 patients; n shown per time point"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}
save_plot_dual(questionnaire_number_plot, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "figures", "missingness_by_questionnaire_number"))
questionnaire_number_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-heatmap
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
heatmap_plot <- items |>
  filter(!is_structural_absence, form_type == "short_version") |>
  summarise(
    missingness = mean(is_missing_nonstructural),
    n = n(),
    .by = c(questionnaire_number, item_position_within_form)
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = item_position_within_form, y = questionnaire_number, fill = missingness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:18) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:11) +
  labs(
    title = "Adapted QLQ-C15-based form",
    subtitle = "Cells with \u003c10 items excluded",
    x = "Item number",
    y = "Questionnaire number within patient",
    fill = "Missingness"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
save_plot_dual(heatmap_plot, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "figures", "missingness_heatmap"), width = 6, height = 5)
heatmap_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-burden
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
make_burden_plot <- function(data, form, max_missing, x_breaks, title) {
  burden_counts <- data |>
    filter(form_type == form) |>
    count(n_items_missing_nonstructural, name = "n_questionnaires") |>
    complete(
      n_items_missing_nonstructural = 0:max_missing,
      fill = list(n_questionnaires = 0L)
    )
  ggplot(
    burden_counts,
    aes(x = n_items_missing_nonstructural, y = n_questionnaires)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.82, fill = "#176B87") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(-0.5, max_missing + 0.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Missing items",
      y = "Questionnaires"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

burden_long_plot <- make_burden_plot(
  questionnaires,
  form = "long_version",
  max_missing = 31,
  x_breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5),
  title = "EORTC QLQ-C30"
)

burden_short_plot <- make_burden_plot(
  questionnaires,
  form = "short_version",
  max_missing = 18,
  x_breaks = seq(0, 18, by = 3),
  title = "Adapted QLQ-C15-based form"
)

burden_plot <- burden_long_plot + burden_short_plot
save_plot_dual(burden_plot, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "figures", "missingness_burden"), width = 9, height = 5)
burden_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-noquestionnaire
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
noquestionnaire_plot <- questionnaires |>
  group_by(noquestionnaire) |>
  summarise(
    prop_any_missing = mean(n_items_missing_nonstructural > 0),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(noquestionnaire = forcats::fct_reorder(noquestionnaire, prop_any_missing)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = prop_any_missing, y = noquestionnaire)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(prop_any_missing, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    x = "Questionnaires with any missing item",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

save_plot_dual(noquestionnaire_plot, here("output", "02_missingness_descriptive", "figures", "noquestionnaire"), width = 6, height = 4)
noquestionnaire_plot
```
